title: Dialetto, ma Quanto Dialetto? Transcribing and Evaluating Dialects on a Continuum

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot speech-to-text performance (using Whisper) across a geographical continuum of Italian dialects and correlating the performance disparities (measured via BLEU and chrF scores) with phonetic similarity to the standard language variety and geographic proximity using geostatistical and dialectometric analysis.
